text:
Nora Chen: Hey folks — quick onboarding question. I just added my spouse as a dependent in the benefits portal but I still see last week's premium on my paystub. Also ordered the commuter VISA card during onboarding and it's not arrived. Who should I ping to confirm dependent effective date and expedite the card?

Ava (People Ops): Hi Nora — welcome! Congrats :). For dependent effective dates we need the signed enrollment form + proof of relationship. Did you upload those to BambooHR or email them to benefits@redwood.com?

Nora Chen: I uploaded a PDF of the marriage certificate to BambooHR under "Documents" yesterday and hit submit on the benefits form in the portal. No confirmation email yet.

Jamal (Benefits): Checking — I see an enrollment in Pending for Nora C. Looks like missing the e-signature on the dependent attachment (system sometimes doesn't pick up scans). Nora, can you confirm the filename you uploaded?

Nora Chen: filename is "nora_cheng_marriage_2024.pdf" and uploaded at ~10:45am yesterday.

Jamal (Benefits): Got it, thanks. Can you re-upload but use the naming convention "LastName_FirstName_dependent_[spouse|child]_MMDDYYYY.pdf" and then reply here when done? I'll manually approve once it's visible.

Nora Chen: re-uploaded as "Chen_Nora_dependent_spouse_06012024.pdf" just now. :thumbsup:

BenefitsBot: Enrollment document received. Queue position: 3. Expected processing within 48 hours.

Jamal (Benefits): I manually kicked the approval for your dependent. Effective date will be 2024-06-01 (first day of next pay period). Payroll deduction change should reflect on the next payroll run.

Liam (Payroll): FYI — once Benefits approves, payroll sees the change for the upcoming cycle. If you need retro coverage charge back or reimbursements, let me know and we can check if a manual adjustment is necessary.

Nora Chen: Awesome, thank you both. Any update on the commuter card?

Ava (People Ops): For commuter cards, we order them after the employee completes the commuter pre-tax election. Can you confirm you selected the commuter option in the benefits portal and the shipping address is correct in Workday?

Nora Chen: I did the pre-tax election and the Workday address is correct. Order confirmation email was supposed to come but I didn't get anything.

Liam (Payroll): I'll check the card order queue. Nora, can you DM me your last 4 of SSN and confirm zip so I can look up the order? (I'll delete after.)

Nora Chen: DM'd you the info.

Liam (Payroll): Found it — card was issued but returned to vendor for address verification on 2024-06-02. I've re-submitted with corrected formatting, ETA 5-7 business days. If it doesn't arrive by 2024-06-12, I will issue a temporary reimbursement method.

Nora Chen: Great, thanks Liam. Appreciate the quick help.

Ava (People Ops): Glad this is moving. Summary: Jamal approved dependent (effective 2024-06-01) -> payroll will reflect next run; Liam re-ordered commuter card (ETA ~ 5-7 business days). If anyone runs into any issues, ping @people-ops or email benefits@redwood.com.

Nora Chen: Perfect. One last q — does adding a spouse change my PTO accrual rate or company holidays?

Ava (People Ops): No impact on PTO accrual or company holidays. Only benefits premiums and dependent-specific benefits (dental/vision) change.

Nora Chen: Thanks all! :heart:
